meta.description: A Next.js starter for a site on this platform: SEO, strict CSP, English and Russian, tests, Docker and CI.
meta.ogTitle: A Next.js starter for this platform

meta.title: Next Starter — a Next.js starter
meta.description: Start a site from a working base: titles and metadata, sitemap, strict security headers, two languages and tests.

home.heading: A Next.js starter that already works
home.lead: Every piece below is wired up and covered by tests. Replace these pages with your own; take data fetching through the API from next-example when you need it.

features.seo: Titles and descriptions in both languages, canonical and hreflang links, Open Graph card, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, JSON-LD.
features.security: Strict Content Security Policy with a nonce per request and security headers.
features.i18n: English and Russian without URL prefixes: a cookie remembers the choice, ?lang= switches it.
features.quality: Biome, Vitest, Playwright with axe checks, Pino logs, health probes, Docker and CI.

about.heading: About
about.body: A sample second page. Its title and description come from this page; the canonical URL, language alternates and the Open Graph card come from the layout.
